verdict.why: kaikki-ru-en reads платье as [ˈpɫatʲje]; the model wrote /ˈpłatʲjɪ/

notes: While 'платье' almost always refers to a dress (a garment with a bodice and skirt), the word 'одежда' is used for the general concept of clothing. Do not confuse it with 'костюм', which typically refers to a suit or a set of matching pieces.

senses.definition: A one-piece garment for women or girls, consisting of a bodice with a skirt attached.
